subject.title: Control UI: gateway-owned sidebar section order

question: Should sidebar section order be a gateway-owned layout shared across devices, replacing the merged-but-unreleased config-owned browser preference?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but this changes who owns a user-visible layout preference and determines the supported client-topology contract.

options.title: Adopt gateway-owned ordering
options.body: Approve the shared gateway SQLite layout as the canonical order source and land this PR.

options.title: Keep browser/config ownership
options.body: Retain the prior preference-based design if section order must remain local to a browser or configuration file.

options.title: Pause for topology policy
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers define whether separately shipped web clients are a supported gateway-skew topology.

recommendation.title: Adopt gateway-owned ordering
recommendation.body: Approve the shared gateway SQLite layout as the canonical order source and land this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the predecessor design and authored the current ownership migration, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the design decision.
